Resolution size is only one factor. The refresh rate and the response rate are also factors to consider.

Refresh rate is measured in Hertz, Hz and the higher the better. The people that I play with say that 144hz monitors are very nice. But then again they are more expensive so I don't have one.

Response rate is measured in milliseconds, ms. The lower the better.
